components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width teal action for a currently possible interior flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--teal, #37b7aa); color: var(--accent-foreground, #071716); padding: 0 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 760; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #42c3b6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #61d4c8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Compact slate action for supporting interior tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #282f3a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card-raised, #181e27); color: #bdc8d6; padding: 0 11px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 650; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #3b4554; background: #202834; color: var(--text, #edf2f7); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #61d4c8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Raised-slate field with a quiet ledger border and teal focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #bdc8d6; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border, #282f3a); border-radius: 8px; outline: 0; background: var(--card-raised, #181e27); color: var(--text, #edf2f7); padding: 9px 10px; font-size: 12px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--teal, #37b7aa); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #8794a7); }

components.name: Primary Swap Surface
components.description: The one lifted interior card reserved for the active Swap task.
components.html:
Swap

Enter an amount to inspect the routes that are actually queried.
components.css: .ds-surface-card { border: 1px solid var(--border, #282f3a); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card, #131820); box-shadow: 0 28px 64px rgb(0 0 0 / 25%); color: var(--text, #edf2f7); padding: 16px; } .ds-surface-card strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 680; } .ds-surface-card p { max-width: 42ch; color: var(--text-muted, #8794a7); margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Inset pill navigation with centered route tabs and restrained teal state.
components.html:
OTF
SwapFundsDocs
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; min-height: 58px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(59 69 84 / 78%); border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(15 20 27 / 88%); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 24%); color: var(--text, #edf2f7); padding: 0 25px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-brand { justify-self: start; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-tabs { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-nav-tabs a { border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-muted, #8794a7); padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-tabs a:hover { color: var(--text, #edf2f7); } .ds-nav-tabs .ds-active { background: rgb(55 183 170 / 11%); color: #61d4c8; } .ds-nav button { justify-self: end; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #8794a7); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #61d4c8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: Small uppercase ledger status for factual interior state.
components.css: .ds-state-badge { display: inline-flex; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #282f3a); border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 2%); color: var(--text-muted, #8794a7); padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 0.63rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Splash Entry Button
components.description: The splash's single pale entry action; it does not carry into the interior app.
components.css: .ds-splash-entry { display: inline-flex; min-width: 164px; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #e7f5f2; box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgb(0 0 0 / 32%); color: #071411; padding: 0 18px 0 20px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: 0.015em; transition: background 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-splash-entry svg { transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-splash-entry:hover { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 38%); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-splash-entry:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-splash-entry:active { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 28%); transform: translateY(0); } .ds-splash-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3fffd; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-splash-entry, .ds-splash-entry svg { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The product uses a low-light operational field, teal signals, and thin rules to make financial state feel legible rather than promotional. Swap is intentionally reduced to one obvious exchange task, while supporting routes retain the denser operational language they need.

The splash is a deliberately separate threshold into that world: a full-viewport blue-black plate where fine teal market lines converge into one OTF. It is an established-world extension, not a replacement grammar; the oversized lowercase lockup, code-led field, and pale entry control stop at the app boundary.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, breathable transaction controls with progressive disclosure.
Teal marks a confirmed path or intentional action; gold and rose name caution or failure.
Data is layered by tone and rule, not by an excess of floating cards.
A single stark entry plate introduces the product, then yields to the compact Calm Exchange.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use teal to show an active selection or a confirmed state, never as generic decoration.

rules.name: The Threshold Palette Rule
rules.body: The convergence field is the splash-only expression of teal as many market lines becoming one OTF. Once the user enters, return to the incumbent Night Field, OTF Teal, and ledger neutrals.

rules.name: The Type Boundary Rule
rules.body: Instrument Sans and the oversized stacked lockup are exclusive to the splash; the operating application remains an Inter-led system with modest display headings.

dos: Do make unavailable chain data visibly unavailable.
Do use ordered constituent addresses for formation; allocation belongs to the authenticated snapshot, not the creator form.
Do keep route, fee, gas, and price-impact information separate.
Do leave production liquidity in its official venue with a leaving-app disclosure; keep the internal liquidity utility visibly testnet-only and USDG-only.
Do keep the splash to the product name, the fixed tagline, and one entry action within the first viewport below the warning.
Do confine the oversized Instrument Sans lockup, convergence geometry, and pale CTA to the splash, then restore the Calm Exchange grammar inside the app.
Do preserve the static composition when reduced motion disables the splash animations.
donts: Don't use verification language for pools, routes, liquidity, economics, or investment safety.
Don't report a fixture or preview as a quote, simulation, or submitted transaction.
Don't rebuild the route around equal-sized dashboard cards or a marketing hero.
Don't expand the splash into a long marketing page, card-based hero, proof block, or additional product claim.
Don't carry the splash title scale, flow field, or pale entry control into the operating application.
Don't replace the code-led convergence field with a shipping raster.
